items.title: Use of Machine Learning in Business

source_refs.note: 'Use of Machine Learning in Business' under topic 6.5, as printed (PDF 81, printed 77).

blocks.text: Businesses use machine learning to understand customer behavior. It helps predict sales and market trends. Businesses use it for inventory management. Examples include detecting fraud in financial systems, customer services through robots or chatbots, and suggesting products to customers. Marketing strategies become more effective using machine learning. Business decisions become data-driven. This improves profit and efficiency.
